valuationInputs.name: Beta
valuationInputs.reason: 8 steps, 25 Nov 2026. (1) Business: a Kandy-based licensed finance company: leases and hire purchase about 70% of lending, gold loans about 22%, microfinance/SME and other loans the rest (segments, Interim to 30 Sep 2026, p. 11), plus a 19.5% stake in TVS Lanka (motorcycle distributor, 7% of profit in H1); one sector. (2)–(3) A finance company, so no relevering: the sector's levered beta. Damodaran's emerging-markets file couldn't be opened from this run; the Financial Svcs. (Non-bank & Insurance) levered beta 0.97 (January 2026, web-search extract, as used for HNB Finance on this site) is used. (4) Local 5-year betas: none found. Simply Wall St 1.14 (window not stated) and TradingView 1.51 (1-year, ignored); StockAnalysis n/a. The share traded thinly until the Group Lease stake was sold (public holding 29.5% in March 2026), so no median of three. (5) 0.97. (6) Within 0.3–2. (7)–(8) Into scripts/reinvestment.py; shown as the Required return tile. Replaces the hand-set cost of equity (21% / 19.5% / 18%) of 13 Nov. Refresh in January 2027.

valuationInputs.name: Cost of equity
valuationInputs.reason: From scripts/reinvestment.py (25 Nov 2026): 8.24% + 0.97 × (4.2% + 6.08%) = 18.2%, ±1.5 points. No WACC: a finance company's deposits and bank loans are its raw material, so it is valued on equity.

valuationInputs.name: Long-run ROE
valuationInputs.reason: Group ROE (ten-year summary, pp. 270–271): 16.0% (2019/20), 15.6%, 26.1%, 11.1%, 16.9%, 23.8%, 30.1% (2025/26, with a Rs 4.96bn provision release, p. 161); median of these seven 16.9%. H1 2026/27 profit Rs 3.79bn on equity of Rs 36.3–36.9bn is about 21% a year (calculated). Capital is very high (equity 28% of assets, core capital 27.02% against a 10% minimum, p. 6), which holds ROE down unless it is paid out or lent. Base 18%; bear 14% (2022/23-type year); bull 22% (the H1 level held). Was 16% / 19% / 22% on 13 Nov.

valuationInputs.name: Long-term growth
valuationInputs.reason: Same in every method; below the 12.24% bond yield and the cost of equity, and below the supported growth (Growth check). Unchanged from 13 Nov.

valuationInputs.name: Growth check
valuationInputs.value: Assumed 5% / 8% / 10% (dividend growth for five years); supported 24.2% by the calculator on 2025/26 cash paid, about 12% on the declared dividend (67% kept × 18% base ROE). All within 2 pts.
valuationInputs.reason: scripts/reinvestment.py on FY 2025/26 gives 80.4% kept × 30.1% ROE = 24.2%, because the cash dividend paid in the year (Rs 1.91bn, the Rs 6 for 2024/25, p. 166) is a year behind. On the Rs 10 declared for 2025/26 (p. 17, note 55) against EPS Rs 30.66, 67% of profit was kept; × long-run ROE 14% / 18% / 22% that supports 9.4% / 12.1% / 14.8%. Every scenario is below that. Long-run growth 5–7% needs 36–32% of profit kept at 14–22% ROE, which the stable payout (1 − g ÷ ROE) provides.

valuationInputs.name: Normal EPS 2026/27
valuationInputs.reason: H1 2026/27 EPS Rs 11.92 and Q2 Rs 5.41 (Interim p. 3); × 2 = Rs 23.84, Q2 × 4 = Rs 21.64. The twelve-month run-rate of Rs 29.28 (calculated) is not used as the base because it contains the second half of 2025/26, when about Rs 4.0bn of loan-loss provisions were released (Rs 4.96bn for the year, p. 161, less Rs 0.96bn in H1, Interim p. 3); provisions are now being charged again (Rs 846mn in H1 2026/27) and interest costs rose 34%. Base Rs 23 is 21% below the run-rate for that reason.

valuationInputs.name: 2026/27 EPS × P/E
valuationInputs.reason: Year-end P/E 2.88x (March 2025) and 3.60x (March 2026, p. 275); 3.3x on twelve-month EPS at Rs 96.20 (calculated). Chosen P/Es sit below the justified forward P/E (1 − g ÷ ROE) ÷ (cost of equity − g): about 4.4x / 5.5x / 7.0x, so no scenario implies more growth than supported. P/E multiples unchanged from 13 Nov.

valuationInputs.name: Dividends
valuationInputs.value: Next Rs 7 / 8 / 10, growing 5% / 8% / 10% for five years; then the stable payout 1 − g ÷ ROE (64% / 67% / 68%) of EPS
valuationInputs.reason: Rs 10 for 2025/26 (Rs 3 interim + Rs 7 final, p. 17; Rs 3.18bn paid in H1 2026/27, Interim p. 5) was 33% of EPS Rs 30.66; Rs 6 for 2024/25 (31% of Rs 19.33). About a third of normal EPS of Rs 20–26 gives Rs 7–9; bull assumes Rs 10 is held, which the 27% core capital allows. Was Rs 8 / 10 / 11 on 13 Nov, cut because profit is falling back.

valuationInputs.name: Residual income path
valuationInputs.value: ROE from 21% now to 14% / 18% / 22% over five years; payout 35%
valuationInputs.reason: Start: H1 2026/27 profit Rs 3.79bn × 2 on average equity of Rs 36.6bn (Interim pp. 1, 3; calculated) = about 21%. The twelve-month ROE (27.5%, calculated) is not used because it contains the 2025/26 provision release. Payout = about a third of profit, as for 2024/25 and 2025/26.

valuationInputs.name: Methods used
valuationInputs.value: Justified P/B, P/E, dividend model, residual income
valuationInputs.reason: A finance company: book value and return on equity drive the value; no cash-flow DCF (CLAUDE.md: banks and finance companies).

openQuestions: Second-half 2026/27 provision charges and the non-performing loan ratio (4.71% at March 2026; not given in the September interim).
Whether the loan book grows again (down 3.4% in H1) and the net interest margin as funding costs rise (interest expense up 34%).
The 2026/27 dividend: does Rs 10 hold on lower profit?
Who the new holders are after Group Lease's 29.99% exit, and whether any builds a larger stake.
TVS Lanka associate profit (Rs 705mn in H1).
Local 5-year betas from three sources (none found on 25 Nov 2026); refresh the beta in January 2027.

changeLog.basedOn: Annual Report 2025/26 and interim to 30 Sep 2026
changeLog.summary: Requested from Telegram (/add COCR.N000; note ".N000", taken as the share-code suffix). First analysis: justified P/B, P/E, dividend model and residual income; business tests 3 of 4 (fails steady profit), category 2 (watch list). Price is the 30 Sep 2026 last trade from the interim report because the CSE feed wasn't reachable from this run. The annual report's 2025/26 price range (Rs 103–140) conflicts with the Sep 2025 interim's quarter low (Rs 89.40); earlier year-end prices not available, so P/E history before 2024/25 is null.

changeLog.basedOn: Annual Report 2025/26 and interim to 30 Sep 2026 (re-read in full)
changeLog.summary: Requested from Telegram (/redo COCR.N0000 full). Rebuilt the record to 'report figures only': printed lines for 2024/25, 2025/26, H1 and Q2 of 2025/26 and 2026/27 (comparatives as their own periods), ten-year summary 2015/16–2025/26; removed the worked-out H1 ROE. Page references are now printed page numbers. Added the current template: beta 0.97 (finance-sector, provisional) and the formula cost of equity 18.2% (was hand-set 19.5%), growth check, management and shareholders sections, modelInputs (all four methods computed by scripts/valuation.py). Normal 2026/27 EPS cut to Rs 20 / 23 / 26 (was 22 / 24 / 26) and next dividend to Rs 7 / 8 / 10 (was 8 / 10 / 11); long-run ROE 14% / 18% / 22% (was 16% / 19% / 22%). The dividend model rose most (Rs 76 → 108) because the published two-stage formula raises the payout to 1 − g ÷ ROE after the growth years. Business tests still 3 of 4; category unchanged (2, watch list). Group Lease Holdings sold its 29.99% stake in April–September 2026. Price is the 25 Nov 2026 CSE close.
